1) The presence of an independent national TV channel during the elections decreased the vote for pro government party by about 2 percentage points and increased combined vote for the two main opposition parties by about 2.1 percent; 2) This effect is not driven by unobservable differences between the municipalities with and without access to the independent media; 3) The effect is driven by the fact that the independent media outlet was the only channel that provided the signal of the opposition's chances to win
